subject: Plan: inbound webinar invite sequence - 'Serving LLMs at Scale'
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Plan: inbound webinar invite sequence - 'Serving LLMs at Scale'

Team —

I sketched a pragmatic inbound invite flow for the March 31 webinar (title: Serving LLMs at Scale). Goal: drive 400 registrants, 150 attendees, 3–5 qualified trials/opps. High-level plan below; attached are an invite draft (PDF) and a preliminary segmentation export.

Key audiences (priority order):
- Existing trial users (exclude those with active trials in last 90 days)
- PLG signups with >3 API calls/week
- Mid-market prospects from Q1 SDR outreach (TechScale included)

Proposed schedule (send times in PT):
- Invite blast: Tue Mar 10, 10:00 AM
- Reminder 1: 48 hours before event (Mon Mar 29, 10:00 AM)
- Reminder 2: 2 hours before event (Wed Mar 31, 12:00 PM)
- Recording + follow-up within 24 hours

Asks:
1) Marissa — please iterate on subject lines / copy and provide final HTML with UTM tracking.
2) Aditya — confirm segment counts and remove customers in last 90 days (CSV attached).
3) Connor — coordinate exec availability / who will present for the TechScale thread.

Tracking: I want a single RSVP link per cohort with UTM params so we can see which list converts best. See the Doc link in related_links for a draft.

I've attached: 20260307-invite_draft.pdf and segmentation_list_q1.csv.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: 20260307-invite_draft.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: segmentation_list_q1.csv (CSV)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan: inbound webinar invite sequence - 'Serving LLMs at Scale'

Nice outline — thanks Laura. Quick edits and a proposed send sequence below. I attached an updated invite (invite_v2) with microcopy variations.

Suggested subject lines (A/B test):
A) Join: How to Serve LLMs at Scale — Mar 31 (Live)
B) Reduce LLM cost by 3x without losing quality — live March 31

Top-line email copy (short):
- Intro: 1 sentence about why this matters (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- Key bullets: what attendees will learn (runtime, routing, caching)
- CTA: Register now (primary) / Add to calendar (secondary)

UTM & tracking proposal: append utm_campaign=serving-llms-2026&utm_source=email&utm_medium=invite&utm_content={cohort} and use tracking.redwood.ai/rsvp?eid=RED-2026-0345&cohort={cohort}

Segmentation: if Aditya can confirm list size, I recommend we cap the initial blast to 60k (all cohorts combined) and throttle sends over 2 hours to keep deliverability stable.

Minor: remove promotional-heavy language — keep it technical and tactical (our audience responds better).

Attaching: 20260307-invite_v2.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Growth Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: 20260307-invite_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan: inbound webinar invite sequence - 'Serving LLMs at Scale'

Laura / Marissa — pulled the counts from the CRM. Attaching segmentation CSV for reference. Summary: 
- Trials (eligible): 9,800
- PLG signups (active): 18,200
- Mid-market prospects (Q1 SDR): 4,300 (includes TechScale contact Sarah Lin)

If we exclude customers with active trials in last 90 days per Laura's note, the Trials cohort reduces to 4,900. Total combined target after exclusions ~27k.

I recommend:
- Initial blast to all 27k broken into three hourly buckets starting at 10:00 AM PT
- Use cohort-specific RSVP params so we can attribute registrations back to HubSpot lists (link in related_links).

I've attached segmentation_list_q1.csv. I'll also create static HubSpot lists once we lock the final subject line.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Marketing Ops, Redwood Inference
[attachment: segmentation_list_q1.csv (CSV)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: webinars@bigstage.io, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@techscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Plan: inbound webinar invite sequence - 'Serving LLMs at Scale'

Hi BigStage / Sarah — forwarding our internal invite plan and assets. Can you confirm the following by EOD Tues Mar 10?
- Final event URL with RSVPs enabled and unique tracking parameter support
- Enable waiting room and record-session toggles; produce MP4 + transcript
- Capability to embed our tracking pixel and to preserve utm query params through the RSVP flow

Summary (from internal thread):
- Send: Tue Mar 10, 10:00 AM PT (three-hour throttle)
- Reminders: 48h and 2h before the event
- Cohorts: Trials / PLG active / Mid-market prospects (TechScale included)

Tracking link we intend to use: https://tracking.redwood.ai/rsvp?eid=RED-2026-0345&utm_campaign=serving-llms-2026&cohort={cohort}

Attachments: invite_v2 PDF and segmentation CSV. Sarah — can you confirm whether TechScale needs a co-marketing blurb or logo placement in the registration flow? Connor will coordinate the presenter's slide deck.

Thanks —
Laura
[attachment: 20260307-invite_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan: inbound webinar invite sequence - 'Serving LLMs at Scale' — final send plan

Final confirmation:
- Invite HTML ready (Marissa) with UTM tracking as discussed.
- Lists locked at ~27k (Aditya) — sending in three hourly waves starting 10:00 AM PT tomorrow (Mar 10).
- BigStage confirmed event URL and RSVP flow; final link: https://bigstage.io/event/RED-2026-0345?ref=redwood&utm_campaign=serving-llms
- Reminders scheduled: Mar 29 10:00 AM PT and Mar 31 12:00 PM PT.

Evelyn — can you confirm whether you'd like to open with a 5-minute exec intro or stay strictly product/tactical? If you prefer to skip the exec intro, Connor will introduce the product case and hand to engineering for the demo.

Post-event: we'll run a 24h follow-up with recording + 1-pager and trigger a lead-scoring workflow for registrants who attended >25% of the session.

Thanks all — please flag any blockers immediately.

Laura Bennett
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
